scope: Read-only source/evidence analysis before a next fix; no implementation or new tests

findings.finding: Final CDC IN holds endpoint interrupts and posts a task event. If final completion occurs after the current tud_task, event_ready denies normal grant at pass end; next task can clear BUSY/publish transfer while CTR remains held through the following ADC/RX/prepare/TX/TIME pass. Preparation outside PRIMASK does not itself release CTR hold.

F2 first-close:41 phase/grant calls,15 DATA committed,14 ZERO_SPACE,grant_denied15,hold_final16,hold_time_timer1,hold_budget0,published/completed4651bytes. Supports focusing on final-transfer turnover; does not prove every frame followed H-C1 or establish its latency fraction.

DATA128 arrives every1280us at100k. A max307-byte wire frame requires at most239843.75wireB/s plus control. Fixed max307-byte transfer uses5 USB64 payload packets when not coalesced. This is demand arithmetic, not measured USB capacity.

G2 legacy maxima include completion/drain and have no first-fault phase window.4992 vs F2 2944 is not a speedup measurement. G2 tx_max excludes preparation; F2 includes it. Host read timestamps do not prove host/USB stalls.

questions_before_fix.question: Give a concrete state table for finalIN before tud_task, after task/before ADC, and after a proposed early opportunity: endpointBUSY, event queue, CTR hold, next publication and first possible completion. Mark which transition actually loses a full pass.

If moving the existing normal grant, prove at most one normal6-packet/500us budget reset per foreground pass; outer fallback may not replenish an already granted budget, and lifecycle/early-error progress must remain possible.

Which exact TIME/ADC/loss checks precede the new opportunity, and which RX/Stop/epoch revalidations still prevent writing after an interrupt changes lifecycle? Do not remove guards solely because a profile suggests overhead.

Separate fixable source dependency from sufficiency for stable100k. Preserve same Fs/FIFO/queue/frame sizes and actual failure rules; future physical acceptance must still be one unchanged bounded criterion, not a larger received count.

For TIME optimization, count retained register observations and quantify any changed contract. F2 TIME interval7.7466ms overlaps phases, residual8.5836ms is unattributed; neither is independent CPU% or guaranteed speedup.

Early grant runs inside app scope. Inject lifecycle at its unlock: tud_cdc_n_read also calls read_xfer, so verify no stale RX hardware submit or core consumption before cleanup, not merely no TX; preserve actor restore and skip any second ordinary grant attempt even after a refused first attempt.

rejected_inferences: Increasing queue only postpones an unresolved service deficit
500us/budget increase is not supported as dominant F2 cause by one time hold and zero budget holds
No proof of host bottleneck from nonblocking application reads or chunk timestamps
No proof100k is impossible, and no new physical success inferred from software/source analysis
